metadata.title: TechToJob | A tech community for talent and companies
metadata.description: TechToJob brings developers and companies together in a tech community to share projects, join tournaments, build connections, and discover opportunities.

foundation.title: TechToJob
foundation.description: A community for developers and tech companies.

hero.eyebrow: A community for developers and tech companies
hero.title: Where tech talent gets seen
hero.description: TechToJob is more than another job board. It's a community where developers and companies share what they do, make connections, take part in tournaments, and discover opportunities through participation.
hero.microcopy: Talent, companies, and community in one place.

network.accessibleLabel: TechToJob connects talent, companies, tournaments, and community

howItWorks.title: Opportunities begin long before a job posting
howItWorks.description: You don't come to TechToJob just to find a job. You get noticed by taking part, sharing what you can do, and connecting with people and companies in tech.

steps.title: Join the community
steps.description: Explore the channels, technical fields, and people who make up TechToJob.

steps.title: Show what you do
steps.description: Share your stack, experience level, availability, and what you're working on.

steps.title: Get involved
steps.description: Talk, contribute, join tournaments, and show what you can do beyond a résumé.

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: Professionals and companies can discover profiles, projects, and interests within the community.

steps.title: Find opportunities
steps.description: When a need arises, the connections are already there and the conversation can start naturally.

talentCompanies.title: Two ways in. One place to connect.
talentCompanies.description: TechToJob helps developers and companies discover each other in the community before it all starts with an application.

talent.label: Talent
talent.title: Show what you can do
talent.description: Share your profile, stack, experience level, and availability so people and companies can see what you do and what you're looking for.

companies.label: Company
companies.title: Find people before posting a role
companies.description: Share the role you need to fill, your project's technologies, and work arrangement to connect with professionals already in the community.

tournaments.title: Build something. Share it. Let your work speak for itself.
tournaments.description: TechToJob tournaments are open challenges where you can put your skills to work, build real projects, and show other professionals and companies how you work.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Solve a challenge with your own technical and creative decisions.

steps.title: Share
steps.description: Present your work to the community and explain how you got there.

steps.title: Stand out
steps.description: Show how you work beyond a résumé.

networking.title: Meet people who speak your technical language
networking.description: TechToJob brings professionals from different fields together to share experience, solve problems, discover projects, and make connections in tech.
networking.statement: Not everything starts with an open role. Sometimes it starts with a conversation.

testimonials.title: The best connections start with people
testimonials.description: TechToJob is shaped by people who participate, share what they know, and find new ways to collaborate in tech.
testimonials.disclosure: Sample testimonials for the tournament proposal.

entries.quote: Finding a space to talk about what you're building can change the way you network.

entries.name: Profile 02
entries.quote: Sharing solutions and getting feedback from other technical professionals gives you much more than posting a résumé alone.

entries.name: Profile 03
entries.quote: The community lets you see how people think and work before a formal opportunity comes along.

entries.name: Profile 04
entries.quote: Discovering people through what they share and build gives context that an application doesn't always provide.

entries.name: Profile 05
entries.quote: Tournaments and technical conversations make participation a way to show what you can do.
